items.title: Bitget Hack Losses Climb to $387M: Here’s What Happened, and Why North Korea Is a Suspect
items.summary: An attacker faked internal transfer requests to drain $387.5 million from Bitget's hot and warm wallets, and the exchange's CEO says the fingerprints look like Pyongyang's.

items.title: Bitget Raises Hack Estimate To $387.5 Million As Token Accounting Widens
items.summary: XRP and ether dominate the identified outflows.

items.title: Strategy seeks shareholder approval for daily preferred stock dividends
items.summary: Strategy’s proposal would move STRC and its three other preferred stocks to daily dividend payments, following a similar move by Bitcoin treasury firm Strive.

items.title: Circle and Tether step in to freeze hacker wallet after massive Bitget crypto heist
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer blacklisted a wallet holding about $318,000 in USDT and USDC.
